title: Clockwork Raga
style: The harmonica Orchestrator (MusicOrchestrator): Acts as the master controller. It maps out the universal tempo, establishes a uniform root key, pairs instruments up randomly with distinct world scales, and merges the final file together.The Workers (TrackArchitect): Sub-agents that handle single tasks. A worker receives an assigned instrument and custom scale intervals, writes a custom melodic line, and hands back a finished, independent MIDI track layer.Global Diversity: Because scales like the Japanese In Sen or Indian Raga use completely unique intervals, the tracks retain their distinct regional identities even while playing simultaneously over the same root key.
